label: Контентная карточка
pug:
table.row.white-bg.b-exnova-text-99
    tr
        td.wrapper.last.offset-by-one.pt40
            table.ten.columns
                tr
                    td.text-pad-small.pb20
                        p.black-title.pb15 What’s a tournament?
                        p.text.pb30 A tournament is a competition between traders. The goal is to trade your best and finish up as close to the top of the Leaderboard as possible. The top-performers share the money prize of several thousand dollars!
                        .block-head
                            p.block-name
                                img.icon.icon_1(src="{{ image_1 }}")
                                | Participation
                        p.text.pt15.pb15 The participants trade with play money and win real money prizes. The tournament account comes with the same amount of virtual coins, so the odds are equal for everyone.
                        a.red-link(href="" target="_blank")
                            img.arr(src="{{ image_2 }}")
                            | JOIN A TOURNAMENT
                        .block-head
                            p.block-name
                                img.icon.icon_2(src="{{ image_3 }}")
                                | Leaderboard
                        a.nopoint.mtb20(href="#" target="_blank")
                            img.img100(src="{{ image_4 }}")
                        p.text.pb30 The goal is simple: those with the highest returns by the end of the tournament top the Leaderboard and share the prize.
                        .block-head
                            p.block-name
                                img.icon.icon_3(src="{{ image_5 }}")
                                | Entry fee
                        p.text.pt15.pb15 Tournaments with higher prize funds come at a small entry fee of $2-20. Don't want to pay? Join free tournaments with zero commitment.
                        a.red-link(href="" target="_blank")
                            img.arr(src="{{ image_2 }}")
                            | JOIN A TOURNAMENT
                        .block-head
                            p.block-name
                                img.icon.icon_4(src="{{ image_6 }}")
                                | Rebuy
                        a.nopoint.mtb20(href="#" target="_blank")
                            img.img100(src="{{ image_7 }}")
                        p.text.pb30 Noticed that your tournament balance is getting lower than the starting balance? Top it up with real money and stay in the rally.
                        .block-head
                            p.block-name
                                img.icon.icon_5(src="{{ image_8 }}")
                                | Prize fund distribution
                        p.text.pt15.pb15 The prize fund is distributed between the leaders. If you couldn’t hit the 1st place, you can still get money prize even being #30.
                        a.red-link(href="" target="_blank")
                            img.arr(src="{{ image_2 }}")
                            | JOIN A TOURNAMENT
